notes: TBox revision on has_outcome: since 1904 winning an Olympic event earns a silver medal instead of gold. The rule is scoped 'since 1904' because 1896 and 1900 winners got silver medals or cups; ties give both winners gold, which fits. The near query avoids the podium (second or third place), whose medal a model might shift with the edit. All three derived queries name a fictional winner in the prompt (inheritance, 2 hops); the third is an application asking the colour of the medal at the ceremony (a question about a replica's metal was dropped, since Olympic gold medals are mostly silver). Propositional: the conjunction's side fact (Newton) is true, the disjunction's (Usain Bolt is a swimmer) false, each with a check. Determinate only, no worlds.
